summary: A conditional behavior item (action "None, unless ...") was closed as no-op on 8 hits without opening any of the 5 files, so the unless-condition was never checked.

evidence.output: Applier report: "I did not open any of the five files and made no edits." One tool call for 5 files.

proposal: Applier contract: a no-op on an item whose action names a condition ("None, unless") must cite, per hit, what in the file shows the condition does not hold; a no-op without having read the hit context is needsReview.

summary: Six rendering changes of the 1.0.2 changelog have no item and no informational { text, verify } line, so the run has nothing to send to a visual check for them.

evidence.output: Changed: resize handle shown at rest; empty date-picker mask separators muted; time-picker wheel speed. Fixed: first/last ds-menu-item rounds its corners; chart value-axis gutter sizing; keyboard-focused resize handle shows the focus ring.
informational holds 4 lines: dsPopoverTrigger, time-picker Now, looping column is-selected, time-picker sizer spans. None of the six above.

proposal: Add an informational { text, verify } line for each changelog entry that changes rendering (AUTHORING: "fill verify whenever the line names a layout mechanism"), and a check that every ### Changed / ### Fixed bullet maps to an item or an informational line.

summary: The skill does not say the orchestrator must not pass consumer-intent hints from outside the run into applier or recheck prompts; doing so makes a conditional item's verdict untestable.

evidence.output: First applier wave of this run carried a product-owner decision in the prompt; all three returned no-op citing it. Re-run without it.

proposal: Phase B step 3: the applier prompt carries the item verbatim, the hits and the trees; any judgement about the consumer comes from the consumer code alone.

summary: Phase B step 5 dispatches ds-visual-check with "the app's base URL" but says nothing for a consumer whose screens need a running backend and a login; the run had no URL to give.

evidence.output: This consumer serves screens only with its backend up and a signed-in session; no base URL existed for the run.

proposal: Name the fallback: ask the user for a served URL, or record every rendering change as not-verified with that reason.
